issues.title: Coupon code not applying at checkout
issues.problem_statement: The customer's coupon code did not apply at checkout and showed "Invalid coupon" when used for the Advanced Course.

issues.title: Wrong company name on invoice
issues.problem_statement: The company name in the GST part of the customer's invoice is shown incorrectly.

issues.title: Extending coupon expiry date
issues.problem_statement: The customer wants to extend the coupon's expiry date.

items.description: Support found that the coupon is assigned only to the Starter Course and not to the Advanced Course, and said the product needs to be assigned to it.
evidence: Coupon dashboard mein ye coupon sirf Starter Course ke liye assign hai, Advanced Course ke liye nahi.

items.description: Customer edited the coupon, selected Advanced Course in its Products section and saved, following support's guidance, and confirmed the discount now shows at checkout.
evidence: haan, ab checkout pe discount dikh raha hai.

items.description: Support will check with the billing team about the incorrect company name in the GST part of the invoice and let the customer know.
evidence: main billing team se check karke aapko kal tak bata dunga.

items.description: Support said the customer can extend the coupon's expiry date themselves in the coupon settings, where the date option is found.
evidence: Expiry aap khud coupon settings mein badha sakte ho, wahin date ka option milega.

items.description: Customer will extend the coupon's expiry date.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with clear outcomes.
